name: Taslima Lindström
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Halsted and Division
description:
Taslima Lindström is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 40, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left him with skills and night terrors in equal measure. He works as a face out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Taslima Lindström describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Aybek Herrera-Kyei witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Aybek Herrera-Kyei on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A crew member from Aybek Herrera-Kyei's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
The fixer who handles Aybek Herrera-Kyei's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Aybek Herrera-Kyei represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed. Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.heritage: South Asian dominant (43.9%) with significant Northern European (23.8%), Pacific Islander (12.6%), North African (10.6%), and Sub-Saharan African (7.0%) ancestry, plus minor Indigenous American (2.1%) admixture. This creates a striking Pan-Diaspora phenotype — warm South Asian bone structure and coloration blended with Northern European height and build, Pacific Islander richness, and North African depth.
physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, compact muscle density with a heavyweight fighter's frame — broad shoulders tapering to a narrow waist. Hands are large and calloused, with scarred knuckles. Chest and forearms show pronounced muscle definition.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep tan with golden and reddish undertones — the predominant South Asian ancestry creates a naturally warm base enriched by North African and Pacific Islander heritage, cooled subtly by Northern European influence. Weathered and resilient, maintains depth year-round.
physical_description.complexion: Strong South Asian bone structure with full cheekbones and defined browridges; straight to slightly broad nose with warm undertones. Squared jaw carries Northern European influence. Pacific Islander heritage adds richness and depth to skin coloration. Face is worn but not aged — hard angles accentuated by the blend of South and North African bone architecture. Lines around the eyes from years of squinting. Stubble perpetually at 1-2 days growth. Skin texture shows weathering but maintains underlying resilience. No cosmetic grooming; functional appearance only.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from left temple to jawline, thin and well-healed, partially obscured by hair growth
Cluster of three burn marks on the inside of right forearm — old electrical burns, uniform spacing, deliberate cauterization pattern
Knuckle scars on both hands, deep and raised, telling a history of bare-knuckle violence
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Thermal masking system visible as a faint network of luminescent micro-circuitry beneath the skin across the chest and upper back, most visible when ambient light is low. The circuitry runs in geometric patterns along the clavicle and deltoids. Move-by-wire neural integration visible as subtle subdermal striations along the spine when he moves — the muscle control is unnaturally precise, almost mechanical in its efficiency. No chrome limbs; all augmentation is internal or subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, shoulders relaxed but ready. Moves with controlled efficiency — no wasted motion. Combat stance is his neutral. Eyes constantly scan — threat assessment is automatic. Handshakes are firm but measured, never aggressive. When focused on a target, he becomes perfectly still, predatory.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear — charcoal tactical pants with reinforced thigh pockets, black compression shirt layered under a worn gray canvas overshirt with utility pockets and rolled sleeves. Matte black steel-toed boots, well-maintained. Heavy watch on left wrist (analog, no smart features — redundancy is safety). Light gray neural-dampening jacket (non-branded, military-grade) draped over a chair or worn open. Everything is neutral, durable, and designed for quick movement. No logos, no status signifiers — complete functional anonymity.
